{{Youmay|the spice from [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]|[[Shenir Rix]], the information broker whose name derived from the spice}}
'''Shenir''' was a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] that was trendy on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]].<ref name="gcg">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

The word "Shenir" was also used as a first name for the [[Gender/Legends|females]] of a [[Species/Legends|species]] from Dac, the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]].<ref name="gcg" /> Mon Calamari informant [[Shenir Rix]] used this first name.<ref name="rix">''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]'' and [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]</ref>
